## New element checklist

- [ ] **Playable demo** in `elements/<id>/demo/` that shows the element working.
- [ ] **Module**: dependency-free JavaScript in `elements/<id>/module/` (no npm packages, no network calls).
- [ ] **`prompt.md`, 600 words or fewer**, that tells a coding agent how to wire the module into an existing game.
- [ ] **Self-check** the agent can run after wiring it in (a script or a page that says pass or fail).
- [ ] **Original art only**: drawn by you or drawn in code. No copied assets, sprites, logos, or names of real games.
- [ ] **AI-generated art** (if any) is marked ✦ AI art in the demo and listed for [`PROVENANCE.md`](../PROVENANCE.md).

Maintainers will cold-test the element: coding agents get only your prompt and module and wire it into games they have
never seen. Expect a round or two of fixes before it is published (see
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md#propose-or-add-an-element)).
